doctrine.role: House Tang institutional Tang Champion elite
principles: Use the assigned bow for mounted harassment, disruption, and precision fire while preserving maneuver space.
Charge only when terrain, cohesion, target disorder, and tactical advantage justify closing.
On charge: bow away, cavalry lance and shield ready, keep ordered spacing and mutual support.
When lance reach is lost, the lance breaks, becomes trapped, or close terrain makes it unsuitable: transition immediately to one-handed long sword and shield.
Core progression: BOW -> CAVALRY LANCE + SHIELD -> ONE-HANDED LONG SWORD + SHIELD.
Kill at distance. Charge only on advantage. Break them with the lance. Draw the sword once distance is gone.
Tang Champion is a House Tang institutional rank and remains institutionally owned by House Tang regardless of temporary command assignment
Champion personnel preserve discipline, formation integrity, command continuity, trained personnel, assigned mounts, equipment, and cohesion
Champion assignments inherit mission-specific overlays from their lawful commander without changing institutional ownership
assignment to Tang Wei adds a protective-retinue mission but does not redefine every House Tang Champion as Tang Wei personal property
unassigned or newly promoted Champions remain in the House Tang Champion reserve until a lawful assignment transfers their formation membership

promotion into Tang Champion status transfers conserved integer headcount between aggregate House Tang cohorts; exact identity is created only when an individual later becomes mechanically or narratively relevant, without duplicating a body
doctrine.weapon_transition_rule: Core progression: BOW -> CAVALRY LANCE + SHIELD -> ONE-HANDED LONG SWORD + SHIELD.
